name: Increased Damage
body:
Your caravan is particularly devastating in combat.

Prerequisite: Offense 5.

Benefit: The damage that your caravan deals to foes increases by +1d6.

Normal: A caravan normally deals base damage of 1d6.

Special: You can gain this feat up to three times. Its effects stack.
